name: plyo sit squat (wall)
description: A jumping variation of the wall sit. You drop into a wall squat and then explode upward, building leg power.
instructions: Stand with your back close to a wall, feet shoulder width apart.
Lower into a wall sit with your thighs parallel to the floor.
Drive through your feet and jump up explosively.
Drop straight back into the sit and repeat.
Keep your chest tall and land quietly.
